##### Project general facts

River Villa is a five-bedroom residence by Breig Property, conceived as a private home with a distinctive architectural geometry and carefully considered details. The villa is arranged as connected volumes over several levels, and every bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom, which makes the layout comfortable for a large family or a group of friends sharing the house.

The heart of the villa is a generous open living space that brings together a dining area, a kitchen island, a split-level lounge and a quiet library corner. A rooftop lounge opens onto views of the ocean and the river, while the stairs lead down to a courtyard with a tropical garden and an infinity pool whose edge looks out over the river. The upper level also holds a bedroom with a dedicated workspace, finished with soundproofing for undisturbed rest and work.

Interiors rely on natural wood accents, large windows that draw daylight deep into the rooms, spacious wardrobes and balconies that extend the living space outdoors. The rooftop lounge can be furnished to the owner's taste, leaving room to shape the house around personal preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Pererenan is a coastal village on the southwest coast of Bali, set between the ocean and rolling green rice paddies. It borders Canggu, one of the island's best-known lifestyle hubs, while keeping a calmer, more traditional Balinese atmosphere and well-regarded surf breaks.

Daily life in the area is supported by a growing choice of open-air cafes, restaurants and beach clubs serving local and international cuisine. The wider infrastructure of Canggu, with its dining, shopping and entertainment, is close at hand, so the rural setting does not come at the cost of convenience.

The combination of surf, rice field scenery and proximity to Canggu sustains steady demand for holiday stays, from guesthouses to luxury villas. Pererenan appeals to buyers looking for a quieter retreat that still benefits from the visitor flow of southwest Bali, which supports both private use and rental income.
